prompt:
Photograph of a real 17th-century three-masted merchantman, a plain
working cargo ship under sail, seen from above at an angle: a plain
brown oak hull, low and flat-sided, with a low stern and no castle, a
single row of a few small gun ports, no gilding, no carving, no painted
bands; two square sails on each of its fore and main masts and a
triangular lateen sail on the mizzen, patched cream canvas, tarred
rigging. It floats on the
water, its hull cut at the waterline. Plain flat blue background.
Historical reenactment photography, sharp focus, realistic.
